name: mcpforge
description: AI-native developer workspace that transforms web applications into safe, testable, WebMCP-compatible applications.

scripts.api:dev: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn mcpforge.main:app --reload
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run api:typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run api:lint
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/web && npm run api:test
scripts.format: cd services/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.api:lint: cd services/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
